text: The project was completed with an IDA Credit of SDR 88.9 million (US$125 million equivalent). It successfully restored flood protection infrastructure and strengthened institutional capacity. Pakistan's ranking as 8th on the Global Climate Risk Index in 2019 and its history of 26 major flood events since 1950 underscore the project's relevance. The 2010 floods alone affected 20 million people and caused nearly US$10 billion in losses.

metadata.solution_name: Disaster and Climate Resilience Improvement Project (DCRIP)
